item.title: Santa Barbara Unified to send layoff notices to 66 employees
item.description: The meeting was highlighted by a tense exchange between board members Gabe Escobedo and Celeste Kafri. Kafri did not want to approve the reductions in force and instead requested that the staff present other options so the board could vote later. Escobedo suggested Kafri was "pretending" to not be informed. The post Santa Barbara Unified to send layoff notices to 66 employees appeared first on Santa Barbara News-Press.
